status: Exploratory sensitivity analysis after observing the default run; not a preregistration or independent validation
ranking: First confirmed post-injection alert; earlier is better. Equal timestamps remain ties. No alert through t=3.95 s is right-censored and never assigned a fictional detection time. Pre-injection alerts are recorded separately.
flips: Report every adjacent grid edge where the finite winner set changes, every adjacent edge where the complete ranking/censoring changes, and exact score-derived pairwise threshold frontiers.
controls: Retain all nine other built-in scenarios. These noiseless traces cannot calibrate false-alarm rates.
verification: Compare every single-monitor threshold at all ten scenarios with direct execution of the production simulator; additionally check combined grid corners and defaults, closed-form step-response scores, censoring, ties, and all adjacent ranking edges.
interpretation: Cell counts depend on the chosen grid and are not win probabilities or evidence of a generally superior detector. No recommended tuning, physical validation, or EFMW uniqueness claim follows.
